text.tspan: ESWCap C+R Meter — carrier board Rev C.1
Sheet 2 — C-mode measurement path (K1 and K2 de-energised)
Team Praise Claude · Embedded Systems Workshop · 2026-11-14 · Sheet 2/7
K1B (pole 2 of K1): C-mode NC 10 closed, NO 8 not connected
U3 truth table (A = B = MUXC_A0 on PB3, C = MUXC_A1 on PB4): 00 → X0 R3 98.6 kΩ 01 → X1 R2 993.6 Ω 10 → Y0 R1 98.9 Ω 11 → Y1 R4 1.01 MΩ
MUXC_EN (PB5) has R30 100 kΩ pull-up to +3V3: U3 is off at reset (EN̄ active low).
The DUT is in series with C1 ‖ C2 (C_block ≈ 1000 µF): C_DUT = C_eq·C_block / (C_block − C_eq).
Oscillator: COMP1 drives U2 through PA0, T = K·R·C + T0 (K ≈ 0.085), timed by TIM2. RC step: PA0 GPIO step, ADC1 records V(t), τ = R·C.
FH also: R12, R9/U5, U7 (sheet 3); D6 (sheet 4)
blue text = net name (identical to the KiCad schematic)
green dashed box = inside the STM32; ◦ PAx (J2-n) = MCU pin (WeAct header pin)
small numbers next to a part = its pin numbers
